remarks:
This 60 acre property consists of hunting and recreational land with creek and building sites in Wirt NY, Allegany County.

A strong setup for whitetail hunting, this 60-acre property combines open meadows, hardwoods, pine cover, established trails, and multiple areas for future food plots. Whitetail sign can be found throughout the property, along with other wildlife.

Recent selective timber harvesting has opened portions of the woods, encouraging new growth while leaving treetops and thicker areas that provide valuable deer cover. Established trails offer convenient access for hunting, ATVs, horseback riding, and property maintenance.

Open acreage provides several options for food plots along with wide valley and hillside views, while a portion of the property includes frontage along South Branch Van Campen Creek. Potential sites for a hunting camp, cabin, or future home add another dimension to the property. Electric and fiber optic are available at the roadside, with excellent access from a maintained year-round road. Subsurface rights convey.

Located a short drive from Friendship and Bolivar.

Hunt the ridges, work the food plots, ride the trails, or spend time along the creek, 60 acres with plenty of ways to make it your own.
